citations.title: Daniel Hajj - America Movil

sentences.text: Daniel Hajj Aboumrad, born in 1966, has served as chief executive officer of America Movil SAB de CV since 2000 and has been a director and member of its executive committee since that year.
He holds a Bachelor of Business Administration from Universidad Anahuac Mexico.

sentences.quote: He began his career at various companies within Grupo Carso. Between 1987 and 1997, he held important management positions at companies such as BIMEX, LUXUS, Euzkadi General Tire, and Galas of Mexico.
sentences.text: He began his career at companies within Grupo Carso, holding management positions at BIMEX, LUXUS, Euzkadi General Tire and Galas de Mexico between 1987 and 1997.
In 1997 he was appointed chief executive officer of Telcel, and during his tenure America Movil was established through a spin-off from Telmex.
He also sits on the boards of Grupo Carso and Telefonos de Mexico.

sentences.quote: Mexican telecom giant America Movil announced plans to invest around $7 billion during 2026 in its overall operation, the telco's chief executive officer Daniel Hajj told a conference call with investors.
sentences.text: On strategy, Hajj told investors the group plans roughly 7 billion dollars of capital expenditure in 2026 and expects similar levels in coming years, with figures to be finalised at a May investor day.
He has emphasised the company's 5G network position in Latin America and cost control, noting EBITDA is growing faster than revenue.

sentences.text: America Movil's customer mix keeps shifting toward higher-value services, with mobile postpaid accesses up 9.1 percent and fixed broadband up 6.1 percent year on year in the second quarter of 2026.

Operating leverage is visible in a consolidated EBITDA margin of about 40 percent, among the highest the company has reported, and management expects EBITDA to keep growing faster than service revenue.
The balance sheet has strengthened, with net debt of 402 billion Mexican pesos at the end of June, or 1.31 times last-twelve-months EBITDA after leases, within the targeted 1.2 to 1.5 times range.
